items.problem: `auth.socialVerifyTimeoutMs` has schema `minimum` 0 (settings/core-settings.schema.json:186), and `timed` passes the value to `server-time.network_time_limit`, which throws `RangeError` when ms is below 1 (server/core/server-time/network_time_limit.ts:9). With value 0, a social `Login`, `LinkAccount` and the `google` method of `POST /account/deletion` reach a throw instead of the rejection, time limit exceeded or communication failure that the spec sets. The server still starts with this value, so server/core/routing/tests/settings-minimum.test.ts does not catch it. It existed before the range, and the range raised only period keys to 1. The spec side is D7 of records/review-debt/spec-auth.json
